confirmed.suspectedCause: toastButtons() does not treat [role=link] (or a focusable [tabindex] element with a click role) as a toast action. Gmail's toast actions are spans with role=link. confirmed.verdict:
Confirmed. I reproduced it twice on http://127.0.0.1:8799/fx/r6t5-gmailtoast.html in the 9465 test Chrome, with trusted clicks. After Sift's Archive on the first email, the page's toast reads 'Conversation archived. Undo'. Sift's notice is

Conversation archived. Undo

. In Sift's shadow root, no button, link, [role=link] or [tabindex] element has the text Undo (count 0). The archived email stays gone (mails [2,3]). With ?nodismiss=1 the notice is text only ('Conversation archived. Undo') with no buttons. That matches the code: findPopup's actionable check at generic.ts:5212 also leaves out [role=link], so the toast falls to the 5-second text path. In the control ?btn=1, Sift shows Undo and Dismiss as buttons, and clicking Undo restores the email (mails [1,2,3], __undone=1, the page says 'Action undone.'). With Sift off (Alt+Shift+S), clicking the span#link_undo on the original also restores [1,2,3] with 'Action undone.', so Sift loses an action the original has. The announcement part also holds. A MutationObserver on Sift's only live region (div.sr role=status) recorded only 'Removed: Your class schedule for next week.'. The toast text was never placed there, because the say() in paint() for the removed item cancels the earlier say() from notify() inside its 100 ms timer. The original's own role=alert sits under the inert page, so nothing else announces it. Code check: toastButtons() at generic.ts:5564 queries only 'button, [role=button], a[href]'. Caveat: the fixture is synthetic. Its markup (span#link_undo role=link tabindex=0) matches Gmail's widely known toast markup, and the Gmail adapter already handles Reply and Forward as [role=link] spans (gmail.ts:226-228). I did not check live Gmail. The bug is in Sift's selector either way, because role=link is valid ARIA for a toast action.
confirmed.fix: In src/content/extract/generic.ts, add focusable [role=link] elements (for example '[role=link]:not([tabindex="-1"])') to two places, and keep them in step. One is toastButtons() (line ~5571, 'button, [role=button], a[href]'). The other is findPopup's actionable test (line 5212). If only one changes, line 5416 (pop.actionable && !actionToast) may turn the toast into a dialog. Also check that toAction() and the proxy replay a click on a span with role=link. In src/content/index.ts paint() (line ~415), when a notice was set during the same action, do not let say(t('removed', …)) replace notify()'s say(said). Either combine the two strings ('Removed: X. Conversation archived. Undo'), or make say() append text that arrives within its 100 ms window instead of replacing it.
